text: One hundred and sixty Pips. Each one is born with its own speed.
One bean keeps you alive. Two beans make a copy.
The fast ones get there first.
asr: The fast ones get their first.

text: But speed burns energy, and they run dry.
The slow ones just keep going.
By nightfall, the slow ones have left three times as many children.
Now run it again. Twenty generations.
Every morning, there is a little more blue on the board.
The average speed falls from one point two five, to zero point seven three.
asr: The average speed falls from 1.25 to 0.73.

text: Faster wasn't better. Under these rules, the slow ones win.
